test: MTP (qwen3_next_mtp / mtp) speculative decoding feasibility on 2× RTX 3090
_SUPERSEDED_BY_V3: This v1 file is retained as historical record only. The verdict and recommendation below were derived from a CONFOUNDED comparison (flag mismatch + prefix-caching ON) and have been REVERSED by the v3 clean A/B retest (2026-04-26) which used matched flags + `--no-enable-prefix-caching` on the same 2× RTX 3090 hardware and found MTP k=1 is **+27.5% faster decode rate** (decode TPOT -21.6%), not -12% net loss. See results/mtp_v3_clean_ab_no_mtp.json + results/mtp_v3_clean_ab_mtp.json + results/mtp_v3_summary.json for the corrected numbers, and the README MTP section for the full reconciliation. Do NOT cite the verdict / recommendation fields below as the current finding.
_WARNING_config_confound: This MTP run used `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.80 --max-num-seqs 2` while the no-MTP baseline (results/dialog_baseline.json) used `0.90 / 8`. The published -12% delta therefore conflates MTP-method effect with serve-config effect. The original 0.80/2 was chosen out of OOM caution that the boot_findings block below shows is unnecessary (~0.79 GB per-card overhead, well under the 0.90/0.80 gap). v3 (results/mtp_v3_clean_ab_*.json) re-runs with matched 0.90/8 flags AND `--no-enable-prefix-caching` and reverses the sign.
boot_verdict: MTP boots successfully on 24GB Ampere with gpu_memory_utilization=0.80. Earlier reports of OOM were due to robot_brain Whisper occupying ~1.6GB on GPU0 + gpu_memory_utilization=0.90 leaving no headroom. With those resolved, MTP loads cleanly. Drafter sharing lm_head and embedding weights with target keeps overhead small.

decode_bench.harness: 5 prompts × max_tokens=200 × temperature=0.5 × seed=42 (same set used in baseline)

verdict: [v1 — SUPERSEDED] At publication this said: MTP k=1 is a NET LOSS, mean throughput drops 12%. The v3 clean A/B retest with matched flags + `--no-enable-prefix-caching` reverses this to MTP k=1 is +27.5% faster decode rate. Two confounders explained the original wrong sign: (1) flag mismatch (0.80/2 vs 0.90/8) accounted for ~30 percentage points of the swing; (2) `--enable-prefix-caching` ON during v1 + the MTP × prefix-cache interaction in vllm #38182 (cache hit rate drops 92%→71% under MTP) accounted for another ~10 percentage points. See results/mtp_v3_summary.json for the corrected verdict.
recommendation: [v1 — SUPERSEDED] At publication this said: DO NOT enable MTP. The v3-corrected recommendation is: ENABLE MTP k=1 with `--speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":1}'` provided you can run with `--no-enable-prefix-caching`. For single-user voice-dialog (cache hit rate is near-zero anyway) the cache-OFF cost is negligible. For shared-prefix workloads (multi-turn chat with stable system prompt, RAG with stable retrieval) measure your cache hit rate × MTP net effect on your own workload before enabling — vllm #38182 / #40756 indicate the cache-MTP path is buggy.
what_did_not_kill_it: OOM was avoidable. MTP draft is ~0.8GB extra per card, not a 2× model copy.
what_killed_it: Acceptance rate. The k=1 draft predictions disagreed with the target enough that mean throughput net-decreased.
